name: Dumbbell Woodchop
description: Holding one dumbbell in both hands above one shoulder, chop it diagonally down across your body to the outside of the opposite knee, turning and bending your knees, then lift it back.

source.title: Coach: How to do the dumbbell woodchop
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with feet a little wider than your hips.
Hold one dumbbell by both ends above one shoulder.
cues: Turn from your chest and hips.

prescription.note: Pick a band you can control for every rep; about 2 seconds each way.

keyframes.name: Reach up
keyframes.cue: Side-on to the door, arms up toward the anchor.

keyframes.name: Chop down
keyframes.cue: Rotate and pull the band down across to your left knee.
